g.text: Selected energy: one lattice; energy is free
Again the equation is fixed: the energy is free. The plotted lattice is the lattice of u².
u = √(℘ − 1/3) has a character of order two; its ordinary period cell is twice as large.
Lattice of the full twisted period group Γ · Real invariants do not alone imply a bounded real profile.
